class size is a strong negative predictor of academic interactions with professors, peers, and TAs.
class size is negatively associated with academic social capital for students of color and first-generation students.

the role of class size on students’ academic interactions and how race and first-generation status moderate these effects.
how class size affects academic interactions and whether social groups moderate these effects.

the class size is a factor that affects academic social capital.

class size matters. It affects students’ academic interactions with peers and professors and that these effects are sensitive to social group.
